profile_text.body:
Luma AI is a creative AI platform founded in 2021 and headquartered in Redwood City, California. The company describes itself as focused on video generation and image creation, and positions its technology toward agencies, brands, and creative professionals seeking end-to-end AI-assisted workflows.

The platform is built around two video generation models, Ray and Uni, alongside what the company calls creative agents designed to handle complete production workflows. Uni-1, a more specialized offering, is described as brand intelligence at the model level, capable of carrying style references, character references, and visual grounding across assets. The company has also partnered with Wonder Project on a venture called Luma Launch, which the site describes as combining generative AI with traditional filmmaking through production services.

The site's held facts list Luma AI under the Video Generation and Editing category and note 175 law-related exposure instances tied to California, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the available data.
